title: Zoomies catalog
description: Every problem code and Kennel Club check Zoomies can raise, with what each means, what to do and how to see that it worked.

generated_from.description: The short commit the catalog was generated at, or empty.

id.description: The code, verbatim: a problem code such as jobs.oom_killed or a check code such as ci.no_timeout.

severity.description: The documented severity verbatim; a sentence where the severity depends on the circumstances.

verify.description: How to see the fix worked, or null where the documentation has no such sentence yet.

status_sentence.description: What the public status page says for this code, where it shows it.

setting.description: The configuration key a static problem is about.
